parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: "accepted", message: "Project Management generation started for project: " + ($('Initialize Parameters').first().json.projectSlug || "unknown"), stage: "project-management", workflow: "Project Management", projectSlug: $('Initialize Parameters').first().json.projectSlug || "unknown", projectName: $('Initialize Parameters').first().json.projectName || $('Initialize Parameters').first().json.projectSlug || "unknown" } }}

parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.name FROM architecture.projects p WHERE p.slug = $1;
SELECT id FROM architecture.jobs WHERE project_id = $1 AND stage = 'test-strategy' AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO architecture.jobs (project_id, stage, input_job_id, status, meta) VALUES ($1, 'project-management', $2, 'running', $3::jsonb) RETURNING id, stage, status;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.type) a.type, a.content FROM architecture.artifacts a WHERE a.project_id = $1 AND a.type IN ('brd', 'business_arch', 'application_arch', 'data_arch', 'infrastructure_arch', 'risk_assessment_md', 'solution_arch_md', 'test_strategy_md', 'test_scenarios_md', 'enriched_sequences') ORDER BY a.type, a.version DESC;

WITH next_version AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'prd_md') INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta) SELECT $1, 'prd_md', next_version.v, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb FROM next_version RETURNING id, version;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Pass Context').first().json.projectId, JSON.stringify({ markdown: $json.prdMarkdown }), $json.prdHash, JSON.stringify({ jobId: $('Pass Context').first().json.jobId, stage: 'project-management' }) ] }}

parameters.command: ={{ 'docker exec taskmaster sh -c "mkdir -p ' + $json.repoDir + ' && if [ ! -d ' + $json.repoDir + '/.git ]; then git clone ' + $json.remote + ' ' + $json.repoDir + '; fi"' }}

={{ 'docker exec -w ' + $('Build Git Script').first().json.repoDir + ' taskmaster sh -c "git fetch origin && git checkout -B ' + $('Build Git Script').first().json.projectSlug + ' origin/' + $('Build Git Script').first().json.projectSlug + ' 2>/dev/null || git checkout -B ' + $('Build Git Script').first().json.projectSlug + '"' }}
={{ 'docker exec taskmaster mkdir -p ' + $('Build Git Script').first().json.projectDir + '/docs' }}
={{ 'docker exec taskmaster sh -c "echo ' + $('Encode PRD Base64').first().json.prdBase64 + ' | base64 -d > ' + $('Encode PRD Base64').first().json.projectDir + '/docs/PRD.md"' }}

={{ 'docker exec -w ' + $('Build Git Script').first().json.repoDir + ' taskmaster sh -c "git add ' + $('Build Git Script').first().json.projectSlug + '-docs/docs/PRD.md && git commit -m \"Add PRD for ' + $('Build Git Script').first().json.projectSlug + ' (job ' + $('Build Git Script').first().json.jobId + ')\" || true"' }}

={{ 'docker exec -w ' + $('Build Git Script').first().json.repoDir + ' taskmaster git push -u origin ' + $('Build Git Script').first().json.projectSlug + ' 2>&1 || echo "Push skipped - no remote access"' }}
={{ 'docker exec taskmaster sh -c "mkdir -p ' + $json.sharedDir + '/docs && echo ' + $json.prdBase64 + ' | base64 -d > ' + $json.sharedDir + '/docs/PRD.md"' }}
={{ 'docker exec -w /data/shared/taskmaster/' + $('Build Taskmaster Script').first().json.projectSlug + ' taskmaster task-master init -y 2>&1 || true' }}
={{ 'docker exec -w /data/shared/taskmaster/' + $('Build Taskmaster Script').first().json.projectSlug + ' taskmaster task-master parse-prd --input=docs/PRD.md --num-tasks=20 2>&1' }}
={{ 'docker exec -w /data/shared/taskmaster/' + $('Build Taskmaster Script').first().json.projectSlug + ' taskmaster cat .taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json 2>&1 || echo {\"tasks\":[]}' }}

parameters.query: WITH next_version AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'taskmaster_tasks') INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta) SELECT $1, 'taskmaster_tasks', next_version.v, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb FROM next_version RETURNING id, version;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.projectId, JSON.stringify($json.taskmasterTasks), $json.tasksHash, JSON.stringify({ jobId: $json.jobId, stage: 'project-management', adoWorkItems: $json.adoWorkItems, success: $json.taskmasterSuccess }) ] }}
